reviews.text: We had Jason out to repair our spa heater. He fixed it quickly without trying to sell us anything additional and even showed me how to fix it in the future if it happens again. He also noticed our timer wasn't set up correctly and advised us on how to get that working correctly. I really appreciate how quick and professional he was in helping to get things repaired!
reviews.author: Samantha Goforth

reviews.text: This was my first experience with Serene Pools and I was very happy with the service. Justin was extremely helpful, timely and knowledgeable. He diagnosed the issue and was able to fix it on the spot without a second visit (which usually means added cost). Justin was very friendly, and also kind to my kids and dog. (Goes far in my book). I will be contacting them if I have other issues and if this positive experience is indicative of their level of service, then I would recommend Serene Pools to others.
reviews.author: Jason Bruzzone

reviews.text: Jason and Melanie were fantastic in working hard to get my pool repaired after a majority of the parts were damaged from a winter freeze.  Jason provided me several used parts he had in his shop to expedite the repairs.  One of the parts he provided free of charge was actually discontinued and that alone saved me $2000 by eliminating the need to refit a brand new filtering system.  When it was all said and done, they felt more like family than a pool company.
reviews.author: Trent Davis

reviews.text: Serene Pools is a great company to rely on for swimming pool repair and maintenance.  Recently, Justin did an awesome job in repairing our pool pump which was not priming well. They are prompt, professional and can diagnose and resolve the problem very quickly.  We also have Shawn doing the weekly maintenance and we are very pleased with his work as well.  Melanie is doing a great Job at the front desk coordinating the whole process.  Overall,  we have a very positive and pleasant experience and would highly recommend Serene Pools for all of your summing pool needs.
reviews.author: Viswanath Annampedu

reviews.text: Serene pools is an excellent maintenance and repair company.  They have been doing a phenomenal job with the weekly maintenance.  My technician comes every week as scheduled and my pool is always clean.  During a recent visit the technician noticed a leak in the booster pump.  He notified me and scheduled the repair crew to get it repaired.  I also had them replace my heater as well.  I will be a life time customer!
reviews.author: matt davis

reviews.text: Serene Pools, and our Technician Justin were awesome! They were quick to get us scheduled, arrived on time, assessed the problem and got things fixed.... ALL with amazing professionalism! I'd HIGHLY RECOMMEND them for your pool service needs! Thanks, Justin!
reviews.author: Warren Coomber

reviews.text: BEST EXPERIENCE EVER with a pool company!  So impressed with how fast they responded to our AHS warranty claim when our Filter blew a hole in it and drained 1/2 our pool! They even emailed with us so we could send them pictures so they knew what replacement part to bring!  Justin the tech was GREAT, fast and efficient! The pool went from being 1/2 empty Thursday to up and running Friday afternoon so we didn't have to cancel our daughters pool party on Sunday!  So relieved and happy with both AHS and Serene Pools!  The dispatch process was also AWESOME!  Will use them again and recommend to everyone!
reviews.author: Ryan Cooke

reviews.text: Chris and Melanie at Serene pools are wonderful. They did work on my pool through American Home Shield, and I couldn't be happier. Took a few visits, but that's the nature of diagnostic work. I would use them again in a heartbeat. Very pleased with their service.
reviews.author: Matt K
